summary: Backend-only testing for Inkwell Notes API. Wrote pytest suite (15 tests) covering auth (register/login/me/logout/401), notes CRUD + tag/person extraction, calendar counts, date/tag/person filters, tag & person rename propagation (content rewrite + tags array), uniqueness conflicts (400), location CRUD + note.location_id clear on delete, and cross-user isolation. All 15 tests passed against external https://markdown-memo.preview.emergentagent.com.

minor.issue: delete_cookie does not set samesite=none/secure, so browsers behind cross-site ingress may not actually clear access_token/refresh_token cookies (mismatch with set attributes). Functional via API but unreliable in browser.

Rename uses an in-memory async cursor loop. Safe but not transactional; if interrupted, content and tags array may diverge. Consider $set with $regex update or background job for very large note sets.
No pagination — to_list(500) cap silently truncates. Should expose limit/offset or document the cap.
No bounds validation on lat/lng (accepts any float). Add -90..90 / -180..180 checks.
allow_origin_regex='.*' with allow_credentials=True is permissive; consider explicit origin list for production.

action_items: Make clear_auth_cookies use the same samesite='none', secure=True, path='/' attributes so browser actually clears cookies on logout.
Add lat/lng range validation in LocationIn (Pydantic Field constraints).
Add pagination params to list endpoints (notes/tags/people/locations) instead of hard 500 cap.
Tighten CORS origins for production deploy (currently regex '.*').
critical_code_review_comments: clear_auth_cookies uses bare delete_cookie without matching samesite/secure/path attrs — browsers will ignore the clear instruction for SameSite=None cookies. Use response.set_cookie(..., max_age=0, samesite='none', secure=True, path='/') or delete_cookie(..., path='/', samesite='none', secure=True).
JWT secret key constant JWT_SECRET_KEY='JWT_SECRET' and get_jwt_secret() reads os.environ[JWT_SECRET] — OK, but name is confusing. Consider renaming local constant.
@app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') deprecated in FastAPI — migrate to lifespan context manager.
Seed admin only inserts if missing; does NOT update password if ADMIN_PASSWORD changed (per auth playbook expectation). Should upsert/update hash when env password differs.
Rename loop iterates async cursor and does an update_one per note — fine for small N but could be a single update_many with aggregation pipeline ($set with $function or read-modify-write batch).
No rate-limiting / brute-force lockout on /api/auth/login (playbook recommends lockout after 5 fails).
seed_data_creation: Test created several notes/tags/people/locations under test@inkwell.app and admin@inkwell.app accounts; not cleaned up (tests are idempotent via unique names + conflict handling).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 15 backend endpoints pass against the external preview URL. Use /app/backend/tests/test_inkwell_backend.py as regression suite. Frontend not tested per request. Notable behavior: tag/person names are lowercased; rename propagates to note.content via regex and to note.tags/people arrays; deleting a location nullifies note.location_id; cross-user isolation enforced (returns 404 for other-user note_id).
